REL-FX-1.summary: Evidence-bound COMPLETE. REPORTING -> COMPLETE (API and store.transitionMission/completeMission) only when the mission's latest run is AWAITING_APPROVAL with REPORT + CLEAN REVIEW + non-BLOCKED SECURITY_REPORT evidence whose commitSha == run.headSha (runner stepReport predicate shared via core/workos/outcomes.ts reviewAndSecurityFor). One RUN_TRANSITION journal entry carries the run AWAITING_APPROVAL -> SUCCEEDED move and the embedded mission REPORTING -> COMPLETE move plus completion evidence refs; otherwise 409 WORKOS_CONFLICT with a stable reason (COMPLETION_NO_RUN, COMPLETION_RUN_NOT_AWAITING_APPROVAL, COMPLETION_HEAD_SHA_MISSING, COMPLETION_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_MISSING, COMPLETION_SECURITY_EVIDENCE_MISSING, COMPLETION_REPORT_EVIDENCE_MISSING) and the journal unchanged. Replay re-checks the predicate (COMPLETION_UNSUPPORTED tamper). Engine write paths cannot produce SUCCEEDED or a mission move to COMPLETE (COMPLETION_REQUIRES_EVIDENCE_GUARD). Pure deriveOutcomes(run, evidence) returns execution, functionalAcceptance, security, evidenceIntegrity, recovery, release, customerOutcome with reasons; exposed read-only on GET /v1/work-runs/:id and in the COMPLETE response.
REL-FX-1.tests: tests/v7-relfx-1-completion.test.ts: pure predicate (REL-AT-003 other-commit evidence, BLOCKED security, missing REPORT/REVIEW), honest deriveOutcomes (REL-AT-001 not VERIFIED without oracle), REL-AT-005 API COMPLETE without run/evidence -> 409 journal unchanged, accept writes one combined entry and replay reproduces it, second COMPLETE refused, REPORT for another commit -> 409, BLOCKED security -> 409 via API, forged combined entries are tamper on replay, engine path cannot write SUCCEEDED.

REL-FX-3.summary: Risk-level run admission (D-REL-2). POST /v1/missions/:id/runs refuses missions with riskLevel R3/R4 (or any value outside R0-R2) with 409 {error: RISK_REQUIRES_FOUNDER_DECISION_AND_OS_SANDBOX, riskLevel} before executor selection; store.createRunDetailed refuses the same (WORKOS_CONFLICT RISK_REQUIRES_FOUNDER_DECISION_AND_OS_SANDBOX). The runner WORKSPACE step re-checks the mission record first and, for a journal-injected R3/R4 run, records RISK_ADMISSION evidence and BLOCKs before any clone or child process. The level is read only from the mission record; objective text and the run-start body cannot change it. D-REL-1 (pending): R0-R2 unchanged; the run-start response carries hostExecutionNotice {code HOST_EXECUTION_WITHOUT_OS_SANDBOX, decision D-REL-1, decisionStatus PENDING_FOUNDER, riskLevel, text} and the WORKSPACE evidence note records it.
REL-FX-3.tests: tests/v7-relfx-3-risk-admission.test.ts: R3 and R4 run start -> 409, no run, journal unchanged; REL-AT-021 forged approval/level text in the objective and body does not lift the gate (API and store); R0-R2 -> 201 with hostExecutionNotice; journal-injected R4 run (valid hash chain) is BLOCKED at WORKSPACE with RISK_ADMISSION evidence only, no runs/<id> directory, no child_process spawn/spawnSync call, no implementer call; R1 end-to-end run unchanged with the notice in WORKSPACE evidence.
